trap.label: ênfase com it is
trap.wrong: It is clear titles what attract readers.
trap.right: It is clear titles that attract readers.
trap.why: Por “o que”, o brasileiro usa what na clivada. Em inglês, é that (ou who para pessoas).

mcq.q: It is clear titles ___ attract readers.
It was a famous co-author ___ helped.

opts: It was last year what we met.
Was last year that we met.
It was last year that we met.

fix.wrong: It is clear titles what attract readers.
fix.right: It is clear titles that attract readers.

fix.wrong: Was a famous co-author who helped.
fix.right: It was a famous co-author who helped.

fix.wrong: It was a famous co-author which helped.
fix.right: It was a famous co-author who helped.

rewrite.answer: It is clear titles that attract readers.
It was a famous co-author who helped.
It was last year that we met.
